Argentina defeats England to reach FIFA World Cup final

Argentina has advanced to the FIFA World Cup final after a late comeback victory against England. Two goals in the final minutes secured the win, setting up a championship match against Spain. The match also saw discussion around potential FIFA sanctions for Argentina over a Falklands banner.
